question: How many annual leave days are available?
answer: Full-time employees receive 20 annual leave days per calendar year [S1]. In addition, up to 5 unused annual leave days may be carried forward into the next calendar year [S1]. For part-time and contract employees, annual leave entitlements are determined by their individual employment agreements [S1].
expected_key_facts: 20 days for full-time employees; maximum 5 unused days carried forward; part-time/contract terms are in individual agreements
